title: Compose a chant-driven Big Beat score
description: Use chant-like library recordings as a chopped hook in a new Big Beat Apricity score. Render and measure a short audition before presenting it.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Built Call the Floor: a 116 BPM chant-driven Big Beat sketch using Black Betty both as an intact hook and a four-pad chopped kit. Main 5–14-bar window measured objective_v2 103.46. The steering notch lacked a predicted +2 gain, so it was not applied. Final local render is in renders/call-the-floor-final.
